texts.preamble: K.Senthil vs The State Of Tamil Nadu on 25 July, 2024 W.P.No.18797 In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras Dated : 25.07.2024 Coram : The Honourable Mr.Justice Mummineni Sudheer Kumar W.P.No.18797 of 2019 and W.M.P.Nos.18136 and 18137 of 2019 and 25205 of 2021 K.Senthil ... Petitio Vs. 1.The State of Tamil Nadu, Rep by its Principal Secretary to Government, Municipal Administration and Water Supply Department, Secretariat, Chennai 9. 2.The State of Tamil Nadu, Rep by its Principal Secretary to Government, Health & Family Welfare Department, Secretariat, Chennai 9. 3.The Commissioner of Municipal Administration, Municipal Administration and Water Supply Department, Chepauk, Chennai 5. 4.The Commissioner, Tamil Nadu Food Safety & Drug Administration Department, No.359, Anna Salai, Chennai 6. ____________ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Page No. 1 of 5 W.P.No.18 5.The District Designated Officer, Food Safety & Drug Administration Department , K.Senthil vs The State Of Tamil Nadu on 25 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5890476/ 1 Thanjavur, Thanjavur District. ... Responde Prayer: Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, issuance of a Writ of Certiorarified Mandamus, to call for the records rela the impugned order passed by the fourth respondent in his proceedings in R.No.4049/2018/S1/FSSA/41-15 dated 03.07.2018 and quash the same as illegal and consequently to direct the fourth respondent to absorb and regu the service of the petitioner as Food Safety Officer in the fourth responde Department within the period that may be stipulated by this Court. For Petitioner : Mr.B.Vishnu Chelliya For Respondents : Mr.R.Murthi Government Advocate for R1 and R3 Mr.E.Sundaram Government Advocate for R2, R4 and R5 ____________ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Page No. 2 of 5 W.P.No.187 Order
